articles.summary: Revenue growth reflects first full quarter of VigilAigent contribution and continued stabilization of the legacy business PLANO, TX / ACCESS Newswire / November 12, 2026 / Intrusion Inc. (NASDAQ:INTZ) ("Intrusion" or the "Company"), a provider of AI-powered cyberattack prevention, threat intelligence, and managed cybersecurity solutions, announced today financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Recent Financial Business Highlights: Achieved sequential and year-over-year revenue growth of 84% and 36%, respectively, reflecting the $0.8 million contribution from the recent VigilAigent acquisition and continued stabilization of Intrusion's legacy business. Implemented additional cost-reduction initiatives, including headcount reductions and the voluntary exchange of management and Board cash compensation for equity, to streamline operations and improve cost efficiency while ensuring the Company maintains the resources necessary to pursue longer-term growth
